newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo to show logistics strategy.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo to show logistics strategy.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said chairman Wilhelm Althen will give a media briefing on the airline's new logistics strategy on Friday, November 29.
The cargo subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG said the new strategy was aimed to re-position it in the future air cargo market.

Lufthansa chairman Juergen Weber said in a speech to air cargo shippers on October 24 that Lufthansa Cargo would be developed from a simple freight airline to a global logistics supplier operating as an integrator for standard freight.
This would mean building up a group of selected partners to provide "modular" door-to-door services, he added.
